endpoint.title: Local MOTIS endpoint URL
endpoint.description: Base URL of a self-hosted MOTIS server. Leave blank to rely on the `motis` service registry entry.

transitousUrl.title: Transitous endpoint URL
transitousUrl.description: Base URL of the cloud Transitous instance.

transitousUserAgent.title: User-Agent override
transitousUserAgent.description: Override the User-Agent header for Transitous requests.

dataDir.title: MOTIS data directory
dataDir.description: Filesystem path to the MOTIS data directory (for `license.json` attribution lookup).

providerPolicy.description: Use explicit baseline/regional/fallback provider policy. Disable for rollback.

localRouteOverlay.description: Serve operated route-network geometry from local MOTIS. Disable for cloud rollback.

realtimeCompletenessSkip.description: Skip duplicate agency lookups for MOTIS realtime-merged departures.

itineraryRefresh.description: Issue and accept safe, epoch-bound MOTIS itinerary refreshes.

dataSources.name: Transitous
dataSources.license: Mixed (per upstream GTFS/GBFS feed; mostly open data)
dataSources.attribution: Public transport data via Transitous — see transitous.org/sources/
dataSources.notes: The Transitous public API (api.transitous.org) is 'not intended for commercial or for-profit purposes' — commercial use is decided case-by-case on request, and open-source clients must publish their source and visibly link transitous.org/sources/ for attribution (see transitous.org/api/). Upstream MOTIS is MIT licensed; that software license is separate from OpenMapX integration code, Transitous tooling, and the per-source timetable data licenses (mostly CC-BY / CC-BY-SA / open-government licences).
